detailed_description: The Word to Text tool extracts raw text from .docx files in your browser using mammoth. Drop or choose a DOCX file, wait for the extraction to finish, then review the plain text in a read-only output area. You can copy the text to the clipboard or download it as a .txt file. The tool is designed for selectable document text and does not preserve formatting, images, tables, comments, or embedded objects. It does not support legacy .doc files.
usage_steps: Drop a .docx file onto the upload area or choose one from your device
Wait while the browser extracts raw text with mammoth
Review the extracted plain text in the output area
Copy the text if you need to paste it elsewhere
Download the result as a .txt file if you need a local copy
usage_examples: Extract copy from a DOCX draft before editing it in a plain text editor
Save the readable text from a Word handout as a .txt file
Copy text from a document into notes without Word formatting
Prepare simple document text for manual cleanup or review

faqs.question: Does it support .doc files?
faqs.answer: Currently only .docx format is supported. Please convert .doc files to .docx first.

faqs.question: Is formatting preserved?
faqs.answer: This tool extracts plain text only. Formatting, images, and tables are not preserved.
